name: LEAP Hand
summary: Low-cost, Efficient, and Anthropomorphic Hand — an open-source 16-DOF four-finger hand from CMU that can be built in a few hours from off-the-shelf Dynamixel servos for about US$2,000. Its kinematics keep every finger dexterous in any pose, and it has become a popular hand for robot-learning research as a cheaper alternative to the Allegro Hand.

sources.title: LEAP Hand: Low-Cost, Efficient, and Anthropomorphic Hand for Robot Learning
